description: This Java class, UomWorker, provides utility functions for handling units of measurement (UOM), including conversions between different time units and general UOM conversions via a service dispatcher.

classes.name: UomWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for unit of measurement operations.

methods.name: uomTimeToCalTime
methods.description: Converts a UOM identifier string to corresponding Calendar field and multiplier as an int array.

methods.name: addUomTime
methods.description: Adds a specified UOM time value to a Calendar instance, optionally with a start time.

methods.name: convertUom
methods.description: Converts a value from one UOM to another using the 'convertUom' service via the dispatcher.
